title: Effects of Individualized Exercise Training in Patients With Peripheral Arterial Disease
brief_summary: The study is designed to investigate individualized exercise training effects on arterial function, walking ability and quality of life in subjects with peripheral arterial disease post surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Peripheral arterial disease post surgery \> 1 month
* No discharge of surgical incision
* Intermittent claudication post invasive treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Necrosis
* Above/below knee amputee
* Other conditions might affect peripheral vascular elasticity
